resources.string: Reconnecting to the computer… Your draft is kept.
The computer session is no longer available. Choose a session to continue.
The computer or relay address could not be resolved. Check the address and network.
Connection timed out. Check the address and port. For LAN pairing, use the same network and keep the computer pairing tool running.
Could not connect to this port. Keep the pairing tool running and check the address, port and firewall.
The network connection was interrupted. Check the network and reconnect. Commands will not be resent automatically.
The computer certificate no longer matches the scanned invitation. Verify the computer, then scan its current QR code again.
The certificate is expired or not yet valid. Check the clocks on both devices and generate a new pairing certificate if needed.
The encrypted connection could not be verified. Check that the invitation address matches the computer certificate, or that the relay has a valid HTTPS certificate.
The invitation was rejected or has expired. Scan the current QR code from the pairing tool again.
This phone connection is already in use. Close the previous phone connection, wait a moment, then retry.
The server rejected the WebSocket connection. Check the relay address and reverse proxy configuration.
The computer did not become ready or went offline. Keep Pebrel and the pairing tool running, then check the status on the computer pairing page.
The pairing tool could not access the Pebrel sessions. Open Pebrel and start the pairing tool inside its local terminal, then reconnect.
The connection returned incompatible data. Update Pebrel on both devices and the computer pairing tool, then reconnect.
The computer connection closed. Keep Pebrel and the pairing tool running, then reconnect. Commands will not be resent automatically.
Could not connect to the computer. Check the computer pairing page and reconnect.
The computer invitation could not be saved on this device. Retry saving it.
This is not a supported Pebrel invitation. Scan the current QR code from the computer pairing tool.
Could not read the pane output. Check the computer connection and retry.
Command delivery could not be confirmed. Check the computer output before sending it again.
Input was not accepted. Check the session connection and input permission.
The operation could not be completed. Check the connection or settings and retry.
